Images.Caption: A top-down in-game screenshot from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. A large ship battle is happening between two large stretches of land. On the left landmass is a red-trimmed civilization and on the right is a blue-trimmed civilization. Several ships are on fire between red-trimmed ships and ships flying the skull and crossbones. Over the right of the image stand two characters: Elisabet Ramsey and Morgan Black. Elisabet has a pistol in each hand, wears a black tunic with a brown belt, brown pants, and has shoulder-length black hair. Morgan has shoulder length brown hair and a full brown beard. He also wears a metal breastplate and thick brown leather gloves while holding a longsword in his hands.

An in-game screenshot of a thickly forested area from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. There is a dirt path stretching from the north west to the south east. A large red-trimmed army walks down the path, and toward a small water source. To the north are several blue-trimmed buildings and a large castle in the north east corner.

In-game screenshot of an asian forested area with a wide muddy brown river to the right of the image from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. Several large ships travel along the river. There are several docks and additional Asian buildings on the shoreline. Each building has prominent red roofs with gold trim. A large oxidized greenish statue sits near a high rocky facade. The statue is of the Buddha: a man sitting in simple robes meditating. There are several open shipping crates near the docks with people moving about them.

An in-game battle scene from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. A large stone gate explodes at the bottom of the image with a large blue-trimmed army charging toward it. Beyond the blue army are a few Asian red-trimmed buildings and several Asian blue-trimmed buildings. Patches of green and brown leafed trees appear throughout the scene. A large body of water is to the south west, reflecting the sunrise.

An in-game screenshot of a large ship battle at a beach from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. Several palm trees appear throughout the scene, around the docks and buildings running along the shore. Several blue-trimmed ships are on fire as large galleons with red crosses near closer to them.

A blue-trimmed settlement with a railroad running through it. A train, with animals and longs, travels through. Several tall buildings run along the tracks with people on horseback and on foot. The United States of America flag is on top of several of the buildings. The settlement is surrounded by thick green trees and tall rocky facades.

An in-game screenshot of a group yellow-trimmed troops, on foot and on the back of elephants, stand near a bonfire, staring out toward a large red-trimmed civilization. There are three red calvary units at the gate of the civilization. Red flags cap the tops of most of the large stone buildings within. A few tall trees are the only thing separating the yellow-trimmed army from the red-trimmed city.

An in-game scene of a cyan-trimmed civilization out in the wilderness from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. There are several houses, a town center, and a mill with farmland around it. To the left of the settlement is a black bear attacking a gunpowder unit. Villagers are gathering stone and food.

An in-game screenshot of a snowy landscape from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. A cyan-trimmed civilization has built it self along a shore and up several snowy cliffs. Large ships are docked with their sails drawn up. Buildings are scattered across the varying cliffs. Infantry and cavalry are near the buildings closest to the water.

A side view of a civilization from Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition. A large body of water is at the front of the image with a dock and two fishing boats docked. Beyond the dock are several large stone buildings with brown thatched roofs. The ground has multiple layers that keep getting higher. With each layer are more buildings, reaching up toward the largest building in the distance. Mountains and white clouds are in the distance.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition completes the celebration of one of the most beloved real-time strategy franchises in definitive form with enhanced features and modernized gameplay.

Command mighty civilizations from across Europe and the Americas or jump to the battlefields of Asia in stunning 4K Ultra HD graphics and with a fully remastered soundtrack.

Now featuring two new game modes: Co-Op Historical Battles and The Art of War Challenge Missions, including all previously released expansions and all 14 civilizations, plus two brand new civilizations – the Swedes and Inca.

Head online to challenge other players with updated online multiplayer with cross network play and enjoy modern gaming features including spectator modes and mod support.

Complete your collection with this final chapter in the Age of Empires Definitive Edition journey.
